capabilities: Upload local images to object storage profiles (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Alibaba OSS, Tencent COS, MinIO)
Localize remote images into the vault and rewrite links
Apply naming templates with tokens for local paths and object keys
Batch-upload or batch-localize all images in a note and run a desktop migration wizard
Browse, search, and manage bucket and local images in a gallery
extras: Marketplace listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile is tested on Android only; iOS is not fully verified, and the migration wizard is desktop-only. Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later.
intentEvidence: Common Image Auto Upload setups depend on PicGo, PicList, or similar external services
problem: Image upload workflows usually depend on external tools like PicGo, only upload without bringing remote images back or managing them, and often skip mobile.
